# Js external libraries licenses

Why does *clodo* uses `npm` & an integrated `/vendor/` directory ? Because I added `wllama` after publishing the first version of *clodo*, and I can't integrate `wllama` in `/vendor/` : it is too huge.
\
But even if the project uses `npm`, you'll find all the **Js-related** licenses in this directory.  

wllama 3.8.1 (MIT) is vendored in js/vendor/wllama/ (index.min.js + wllama.wasm + LICENSE).
